hook: A hiker was hurt on a cliff high above the surf.
narration: A hiker was hurt on this sheer cliff, high above the Oregon surf.
This is God's Thumb, near Lincoln City, and the waves below never stop.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Facility Newport moved in over the drop.
Their rescue swimmer rode the cable out of the door and down toward the rock face.
Wind curling over a cliff buffets the helicopter, so the pilot fights to hold it steady.
outcome: The Newport crew hoisted her off the cliff and flew her to the hospital.
title: Hiker hurt on an Oregon sea cliff
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Air Facility Newport hoisted an injured hiker off God's Thumb in Lincoln City, Oregon, and flew her to the hospital on May 24, 2026.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1008137/coast-guard-rescues-hiker-cliff-gods-thumb-lincoln-city-oregon

facts.claim: She was hurt and flown to the hospital
